items.lede: As participants talk, Claude can draft the plan being discussed, map out a timeline on a whiteboard, answer questions in the meeting chat, and access connected work apps to retrieve information, such as last year's figures.
items.title: Anthropic launches Claude Meetings to turn workplace discussions into plans and tasks

items.lede: Claude is responding ‘Yes’ to that calendar invite – with some limitations. Plus: Anthropic launches two more new features that are available now.
items.title: Claude can collaborate in your team meetings soon – like an intern
